title: Enemy body radius limit raised to under 32 px (supersedes REC-6 constraint 2)
intent: Allow a 26 px Giant while keeping every enemy able to path through the city

evidence.description: a Giant from each of the 15 spawn points reached the player with the gate open, slowest 71.5 s, none inside a solid

constraints.statement: Enemy radius stays under 32 px, since the narrowest gaps are 64 px and the nav grid has no clearance model; each radius in use must be walked to the player from every spawn point before it ships

result.summary: REC-6 still says at most 20 px; the CLI cannot amend it
